abstract: Maintains marine zone transit clearances and coastal state maritime safety permits
system_message:
You are the Maritime navigation and regulatory officer (NAVREG), responsible for maintaining marine zone transit clearances and coastal state maritime safety permits, as well as managing notice to mariners issuance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Notice to mariners issuance（NOTMAR）
information_points.content:
NAVREG-NOTMAR-0WL：Optical Time-Domain Reflectometry with Subsea ROV Tracking has a notice publication lead time of 72 h between the exclusion zone broadcast and vessel entry.
NAVREG-NOTMAR-J5R：Autonomous Magnetometric Towfish Survey has a notice publication lead time of 48 h between the exclusion zone broadcast and vessel entry.
NAVREG-NOTMAR-MNA：DeepScan Remotely Operated Acoustic Profiling has a notice publication lead time of 24 h between the exclusion zone broadcast and vessel entry.

information_points.title: Maintains marine zone transit clearances and coastal state maritime safety permits（CORR）
information_points.content:
NAVREG-CORR-PDN：For Optical Time-Domain Reflectometry with Subsea ROV Tracking, formal coastal state corridor navigation clearance across the subsea interconnector protection corridor is approved.
NAVREG-CORR-Y3T：For DeepScan Remotely Operated Acoustic Profiling, formal coastal state corridor navigation clearance across the subsea interconnector protection corridor is approved.
NAVREG-CORR-AFG：For Autonomous Magnetometric Towfish Survey, formal coastal state corridor navigation clearance across the subsea interconnector protection corridor is not approved.
